name: VisionID
postCreateCommand: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'pkill -f "uvicorn backend.main:app" || true; VISIONID_EPHEMERAL=1 VISIONID_RESET_ON_STARTUP=1 nohup python -m uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 >/tmp/visionid.log 2>&1 &'
